_comment: The analytics events the apps may send, once (NP-APP-TELEMETRY-001 §3 and §7; REQ-SW03-07). The shared core reads this file at build time (common/npps-core/src/analytics.rs, op checkAnalyticsEvent) and every app asks the core, so iOS and Android cannot disagree about what leaves the phone. It is an ALLOWLIST: an event is sent only if its name has the allowed shape and contains none of the forbidden terms, and every property is named here and carries a value of one of its forms. A property not named here, or a value not of its form, drops the whole event; there is no list of keys to forbid, because a key nobody thought of would pass one. A form is {literal: [..]} (one of these exact texts), {digits: {max}} (digits only, at most max of them), {prefixDigits: {prefix, max}} (the prefix then digits, at most max of them) or {dotted: {prefixes, parts, max}} (one of the prefixes and a space, then `parts` numbers joined by dots, each at most max digits; with no prefixes, just the numbers). To add a property or a value, change the spec (NP-APP-TELEMETRY-001 §3, Privacy Lead review) and this file together. The bounds on digits and the event-name shape are not in the spec: docs/status/unjustified-choices.md UC-094.
